data.name: Nafasat
data.gender_notes: Nafasat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Nafasat means 'breathed upon', 'inspired'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'nafas', meaning 'breath' or 'inspiration'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Allah (God) breathes His spirit into every human being at the moment of birth. The name Nafasat carries the meaning “Breathed upon, inspired” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nafasat usually hope their child will grow to embody breathed upon, inspired and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies the divine inspiration and breath of life bestowed by Allah upon every human being.
data.etymology: Nafasat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breathed upon, inspired.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nafasat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
